subject.title: feat(control-ui): multi-pane split view for chat

question: After the subscription cleanup blocker is fixed, should this PR's arbitrary persisted multi-pane Control UI chat model be accepted as the product direction for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/100690?
rationale: The PR adds a new user-facing chat mode plus a persisted UI layout setting, and the protected maintainer label means automation should not choose the final product boundary.

options.title: Accept after lifecycle fix
options.body: Require explicit pane subscription teardown, refresh the branch, and then continue reviewing this arbitrary-pane implementation as the intended feature.

options.title: Narrow the first version
options.body: Ask for a smaller two-pane MVP if maintainers want the workflow but not the full arbitrary tiling model yet.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the linked issue open for product discussion and do not merge this branch until the Control UI split-view direction is re-scoped.

recommendation.title: Accept after lifecycle fix
recommendation.body: Require explicit pane subscription teardown, refresh the branch, and then continue reviewing this arbitrary-pane implementation as the intended feature.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete filed the feature issue, authored this implementation, and has the strongest sampled recent history in the affected Control UI chat surface.
